name: Harness Baseline v1
purpose: Make implementation and runtime verification reproducible by an independent actor without GitHub or builder-session access.
invariants: Connection existence is not capability availability.
Capability availability is not execution verification.
A failed request is never recorded as saved.
Generated evidence records source and dirty state.
A verified subject never embeds the final attestation that verifies that same subject.
An attestation verifies an exact subject commit; the subject commit does not contain that attestation.
The latest attestation pointer is external operational state.
